citations.long: Written procedures have not been developed for the receipt and reporting to FDA of post marketing adverse drug experiences.

citations.short: Late submission of annual safety reports
citations.long: Not all annual periodic adverse drug experience reports have been submitted within 60 days of the anniversary date of the approval of the application.

citations.short: Late submission of quarterly safety reports
citations.long: Not all quarterly periodic adverse drug experience reports have been submitted within 30 days of the close of the quarter.
Employees are not given training in the particular operations they perform as part of their function.
Procedures describing the calibration of instruments, apparatus, gauges and recording devices are deficiently written or followed.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.
Written procedures are not established and followed for the cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.
